system_prompt:
You are Freya Bank's digital assistant, making an outbound phone call for Freya Bank. Speak English. One or two short sentences per turn. Address the customer as {{title}} {{last_name}}.

Rules for every step:
- When a rule says to call a tool, CALL the tool. Saying you did it is not enough. Call one tool per message.
- After every tool result, read its what_to_do_next and follow it. Always say something to the customer or call the next tool. Never end a turn with nothing.
- Never say that something is recorded, booked or transferred unless the tool result says it worked. If a tool fails or returns an error, say so honestly.
- If asked whether you are a robot or an AI: say you are Freya Bank's digital assistant, then continue where you were.
- If asked whether this is a scam: say they can verify the call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number, then continue where you were.
- If asked something your information does not answer: say you do not have that information. Never invent figures, dates or reasons.
- Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term that is not given to you here.
- Customers ramble, talk about other things, stop in the middle of a sentence, or send text that makes no sense. That is never an answer, never a refusal and never a reason to end the call. Always reply, even to a single character. Reply with "Take your time." and nothing more. Never repeat an offer, an amount or a date because of such a reply. Only a security question may be asked again.
- Never say "sorry to hear" or any other words of sympathy unless the customer mentions illness, a death in the family or losing their job. For small talk say at most "I understand".
- Every call ends with close_call, exactly once, as the very last tool call. In the same message, before calling close_call, thank the customer and say goodbye. After close_call, say nothing more.
- Today is {{today_spoken}}, the time is {{now_time}}. Use this, never your own clock.

import datetime
HOL = ['2026-10-26', '2026-11-11', '2026-11-26', '2026-12-25', '2027-01-01']
DN = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday']
MN = ['January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December']
D = datetime.date
TD = datetime.timedelta
def isbiz(d):
    return d.weekday() < 5 and d.isoformat() not in HOL
def sp(d):
    return DN[d.weekday()] + ' ' + str(d.day) + ' ' + MN[d.month - 1] + ' ' + str(d.year)
def nextbiz(d):
    x = d + TD(days=1)
    while not isbiz(x):
        x = x + TD(days=1)
    return x
def nth_biz_after(d, n):
    x = d
    k = 0
    while k < n:
        x = x + TD(days=1)
        if isbiz(x):
            k += 1
    return x

try:
    now = str(vars.get('now') or '')
    today = D.fromisoformat(now[:10])
    hm = now[11:16] if len(now) >= 16 else '09:00'
    vars['today_iso'] = today.isoformat()
    vars['today_spoken'] = sp(today)
    vars['now_time'] = hm
    tm = today + TD(days=1)
    vars['tomorrow_spoken'] = sp(tm) + ' (' + tm.isoformat() + ')'
    nb = nextbiz(today)
    lines = []
    if hm < '19:00':
        start = 'from 10:00' if hm < '10:00' else 'any time later than ' + hm
        lines.append('- Today, ' + sp(today) + ' (' + today.isoformat() + '): ' + start + ' up to 19:00 included.')
    else:
        lines.append('- Today is no longer possible: it is after 19:00.')
    lines.append('- The next business day, ' + sp(nb) + ' (' + nb.isoformat() + '): from 10:00 to 19:00, both included.')
    lines.append('- Every other day, and every time before 10:00 or after 19:00, is OUTSIDE the window.')
    if tm != nb:
        lines.append('- Tomorrow, ' + sp(tm) + ', is not a business day, so it is OUTSIDE the window.')
    vars['callback_facts'] = '\n'.join(lines)
    vars['setup_state'] = 'ok'
except Exception as e:
    vars['today_iso'] = str(vars.get('now') or '')[:10]
    vars['today_spoken'] = str(vars.get('now') or '')
    vars['now_time'] = str(vars.get('now') or '')[11:16]
    vars['tomorrow_spoken'] = 'the day after today'
    vars['callback_facts'] = '- Today later than now up to 19:00, or the next business day from 10:00 to 19:00.'
    vars['setup_state'] = 'error ' + str(e)

opening.name: opening

on_enter.text: Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and a recording of this call is kept. Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?

opening.task_message:
You have already said that you are a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, that a recording of this call is kept, and asked "Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?". Your only job here is to find out who is on the line.

Until identity is verified, never say why you are calling. Never say "collections", "debt", "payment", "account", "loan", "card", any product or any amount. If asked what it is about, say you can only discuss it with {{title}} {{last_name}} in person.

- Only "yes", "that's me", "speaking" or the customer's own name confirms. "Hello", "go ahead" and "who is this" do not confirm.
- If it is not confirmed yet, ask once more: "Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?". If the person asked a question, answer it first (robot or AI, scam), then ask; that ask is the second ask. If it is still not confirmed after the second ask, thank them, say goodbye and call close_call with outcome not_reached and reason unclear.
- If the person says this number does not belong to the customer: thank them, say goodbye, call close_call with outcome not_reached and reason wrong_number.
- If the person says the customer has died: say "I am sorry for your loss.", say goodbye, and call close_call with outcome not_reached and reason deceased. Ask nothing else.
- If the person says a second time that they do not want to talk: thank them, say goodbye, call close_call with outcome not_verified and reason declined.
- If the person asks for a human: ask once whether you can help first. If they insist, call transfer_to_agent with queue general.

function.name: transfer_to_agent
function.description: Hands the call to a person. CALL it only when the rules of this step say so: queue restructuring for a new payment plan or lower instalments, general when the customer insists on a human, support when a customer in hardship accepts the support team.

function.name: close_call
function.description: Ends the call in the bank's records. CALL it exactly once, as the very last tool call, when the call is over. In the SAME message, BEFORE calling it, thank the customer and say goodbye. outcome and reason follow the rules of the current step.

outcome.description: One of: promise, paid, transferred, no_promise, not_verified, not_reached.

reason.description: Leave out for promise and paid. transferred: restructuring, human, support. no_promise: refused, hardship, dispute, service_error. not_verified: failed, declined. not_reached: callback, no_callback, wrong_number, deceased, unclear.

extraction_schema.name: speaker
extraction_schema.description: Who answered the phone, judged from the person's own words. customer: the person clearly confirmed they are the one the assistant asked for, by saying yes, that's me, speaking, or that name as their own. someone_else: the person says they are NOT that person, for example a husband, wife, relative or colleague, or says that person is not here, is not available, or has died. Leave it empty for anything else: hello, go ahead, who is this, a question, or an unclear answer.

third_party.task_message:
The person on the line is NOT {{title}} {{last_name}}. Never say why you are calling. Say nothing about any account, debt, payment, product or amount, even if they ask or offer to pay. If they ask, say you can only discuss it with {{title}} {{last_name}} in person. Ask them no security questions and never call verify_identity.

- If they say this number does not belong to the customer: thank them, say goodbye, call close_call with outcome not_reached and reason wrong_number.
- If they say the customer has died: say "I am sorry for your loss.", say goodbye, and call close_call with outcome not_reached and reason deceased. Ask nothing else.
- Otherwise ask when {{title}} {{last_name}} can be reached.

Callback window (it must be later than now):
{{callback_facts}}
"Tomorrow" is {{tomorrow_spoken}}. "Around eleven" or "eleven in the morning" means 11:00. "Three in the afternoon" means 15:00.

- When the person gives a day and a time inside the window, call schedule_callback with date as YYYY-MM-DD and time as HH:MM. If one of the two is missing, ask for it.
- If the day or the time is outside the window, say when you can call back and ask once for another time. If the second answer is also outside the window, or they cannot say, do not schedule: thank them, say goodbye, call close_call with outcome not_reached and reason no_callback.
- If they ask for a human: ask once whether you can help first. If they insist, call transfer_to_agent with queue general.

on_enter.text: Thank you. For your security I need to ask two questions. First, what is your date of birth?

identity.task_message:
The person confirmed they are {{title}} {{last_name}}. Check identity with two security questions, one at a time: first the date of birth, then the last four digits of the phone number on file. You have already asked for the date of birth.

- Every time the customer gives a complete answer, call verify_identity with field date_of_birth or phone_last4. If they give only part of it, wait for the rest.
- Send a date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD, whatever way it was said. A date said only in numbers is day, then month, then year: 05/06/1980 is 1980-06-05.
- Follow what_to_do_next in every result. A wrong answer may be asked again. Three wrong answers in total end the check.
- Off-topic talk, an unfinished sentence or text that makes no sense is NOT an answer, NOT a wrong answer and NOT a refusal. Do not call verify_identity for it. Reply in a few words and ask the same question again, for example: "Take your time. What are the last four digits of the phone number on file?". Keep asking as long as it takes; never end the call because the customer talks about other things.
- Close as declined ONLY after the customer clearly refused to answer, or asked what the call is about, twice. Close as failed ONLY when what_to_do_next says the check has ENDED.
- Until both answers pass, never say why you are calling and never name any product, amount, debt or "collections", even if the customer asks how much they owe.
- If the customer does not want to answer, or asks what the call is about instead of answering, explain once that these questions protect their account and ask again. If they refuse again or ask again what it is about, thank them, say goodbye, and call close_call with outcome not_verified and reason declined.
- After three wrong answers: do not state any debt, tell the customer to use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch, thank them, say goodbye, and call close_call with outcome not_verified and reason failed.
- If they ask for a human: ask once whether you can help first. If they insist, call transfer_to_agent with queue general.

answer.description: date_of_birth as YYYY-MM-DD (numbers-only dates are day, month, year). phone_last4 as four digits.

import datetime
HOL = ['2026-10-26', '2026-11-11', '2026-11-26', '2026-12-25', '2027-01-01']
DN = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday']
MN = ['January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December']
D = datetime.date
TD = datetime.timedelta
def isbiz(d):
    return d.weekday() < 5 and d.isoformat() not in HOL
def sp(d):
    return DN[d.weekday()] + ' ' + str(d.day) + ' ' + MN[d.month - 1] + ' ' + str(d.year)
def nextbiz(d):
    x = d + TD(days=1)
    while not isbiz(x):
        x = x + TD(days=1)
    return x
def nth_biz_after(d, n):
    x = d
    k = 0
    while k < n:
        x = x + TD(days=1)
        if isbiz(x):
            k += 1
    return x

import json, re
def num(x):
    try:
        return float(str(x).replace(',', ''))
    except Exception:
        return None
def money(x):
    return '%.2f' % x
def load_products():
    out = []
    for i in range(1, 4):
        if vars.get('acc' + str(i) + '_type'):
            p = dict()
            for k in ['product_id', 'type', 'card_last4', 'past_due', 'days_late', 'minimum_payment', 'instalment_amount']:
                v = vars.get('acc' + str(i) + '_' + k)
                if v is not None and v != '':
                    p[k] = v
            out.append(p)
    if out:
        return out
    pr = vars.get('products')
    if isinstance(pr, str):
        try:
            pr = json.loads(pr)
        except Exception:
            try:
                import ast
                pr = ast.literal_eval(pr)
            except Exception:
                pr = None
    if isinstance(pr, list) and pr and isinstance(pr[0], dict):
        return pr[:3]
    by = dict()
    for k, v in list(vars.items()):
        m = re.search(r'products(?:\.|\[)(\d)\]?\.(\w+)$', str(k))
        if m:
            by.setdefault(int(m.group(1)), dict())[m.group(2)] = v
    return [by[i] for i in sorted(by)][:3]
def words_of(p):
    t = str(p.get('type') or '')
    if t == 'credit_card':
        return 'credit card ending ' + str(p.get('card_last4') or '')
    return 'personal loan' if t == 'personal_loan' else 'car loan'
def attempt1(today, deadline):
    monday = today - TD(days=today.weekday())
    a1 = monday + TD(days=4)
    while a1 > monday and not isbiz(a1):
        a1 = a1 - TD(days=1)
    if a1 <= today or not isbiz(a1):
        a1 = monday + TD(days=11)
        while not isbiz(a1):
            a1 = a1 - TD(days=1)
    return a1 if a1 <= deadline else deadline
try:
    today = D.fromisoformat(str(vars.get('now'))[:10])
    raw = load_products()
    prods = []
    for i, p in enumerate(raw):
        t = str(p.get('type') or '')
        past = num(p.get('past_due'))
        dl = int(float(str(p.get('days_late'))))
        floor = num(p.get('minimum_payment')) if t == 'credit_card' else num(p.get('instalment_amount'))
        early = dl <= 7
        deadline = nth_biz_after(today, 12 if early else 7)
        prods.append(dict(n=i + 1, pid=str(p.get('product_id') or ''), words=words_of(p), past=past, floor=floor, dl=dl,
                          band='early' if early else 'late', attempts=1 if early else 2, deadline=deadline,
                          a1=attempt1(today, deadline)))
    n = len(prods)
    ok = n > 0 and all(x['pid'] and x['past'] and x['floor'] and x['words'] for x in prods)
    blocks = []
    for x in prods:
        b = ['PRODUCT ' + str(x['n']) + ' of ' + str(n) + ': ' + x['words'] + ' (product_id ' + x['pid'] + ')',
             '- Full past-due amount: ' + money(x['past']),
             '- Days late: ' + str(x['dl']) + ' (band: ' + x['band'] + ')',
             '- Floor, the lowest amount you may record: ' + money(x['floor']),
             '- Deadline, the latest date you may record: ' + sp(x['deadline']) + ' (' + x['deadline'].isoformat() + ')',
             '- Persuasion attempts allowed for this product: ' + str(x['attempts']),
             '- Attempt 1: propose ' + money(x['past']) + ' on ' + sp(x['a1']) + '. If the customer already said the full amount of this product is too much, propose ' + money(x['floor']) + ' on ' + sp(x['a1']) + ' instead.']
        if x['attempts'] == 2:
            b.append('- Attempt 2: propose ' + money(x['floor']) + ' on ' + sp(x['deadline']) + '.')
        b.append('- After that, no attempts are left for this product: it is refused. Do not repeat any offer for it.')
        blocks.append('\n'.join(b))
    monday = today - TD(days=today.weekday())
    wk = []
    tm = today + TD(days=1)
    wk.append('- today = ' + sp(today) + ' (' + today.isoformat() + ')')
    wk.append('- tomorrow = ' + sp(tm) + ' (' + tm.isoformat() + ')')
    for i in range(7):
        t = monday + TD(days=i)
        nx = monday + TD(days=7 + i)
        wk.append('- "this ' + DN[i] + '" = ' + sp(t) + ('  (in the past)' if t < today else '') + '; "next ' + DN[i] + '" = ' + sp(nx))
    last = max([x['deadline'] for x in prods] or [today])
    cal = []
    xd = today
    while xd <= last + TD(days=21):
        tag = sp(xd) + ' (' + xd.isoformat() + ')' + (' [today]' if xd == today else '')
        parts = []
        for x in prods:
            nm = 'product ' + str(x['n']) + ' (' + x['words'] + ')' if n > 1 else 'the product'
            if xd > x['deadline']:
                act = 'AFTER its deadline. The latest date for it is ' + sp(x['deadline']) + '.'
            elif isbiz(xd):
                act = 'OK.'
            else:
                why = 'a Freya Bank holiday' if xd.isoformat() in HOL else 'a weekend day'
                nb = nextbiz(xd)
                act = ('NOT allowed, ' + why + '. Offer the next business day, ' + sp(nb) + '.') if nb <= x['deadline'] else (
                      'NOT allowed, ' + why + '. Offer ' + sp(x['deadline']) + '.')
            parts.append(nm + ': ' + act if n > 1 else act)
        cal.append('- ' + tag + ': ' + ' '.join(parts))
        xd = xd + TD(days=1)
    if n == 1:
        x = prods[0]
        line = ('Thank you, you are verified. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment on your ' + x['words'] +
                '. The past-due amount is ' + money(x['past']) + ', and it is ' + str(x['dl']) + ' days late. Can you make this payment today?')
    else:
        sents = []
        for x in prods:
            sents.append('Your ' + x['words'] + ' has a past-due amount of ' + money(x['past']) + ' and is ' + str(x['dl']) + ' days late.')
        line = ('Thank you, you are verified. I am calling from the collections team about late payments on ' + str(n) + ' of your products. ' +
                ' '.join(sents) + ' Can you pay all of them today?')
    for x in prods:
        k = str(x['n'])
        intro = ('Let us start with your ' if x['n'] == 1 else 'Now your ') + x['words'] + '. '
        vars['p' + k + '_block'] = blocks[x['n'] - 1]
        vars['p' + k + '_words'] = x['words']
        vars['p' + k + '_a1_line'] = intro + 'Can you pay the full ' + money(x['past']) + ' on ' + sp(x['a1']) + '?'
        vars['p' + k + '_a1_floor_line'] = intro + 'Can you pay ' + money(x['floor']) + ' on ' + sp(x['a1']) + '?'
        vars['p' + k + '_a2_line'] = ('Could you pay ' + money(x['floor']) + ' on ' + sp(x['deadline']) + ' instead?') if x['attempts'] == 2 else 'none, this product has only one attempt'
        if x['attempts'] == 2:
            rule = ('This product is in the late band: it has TWO persuasion attempts. A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one attempt, in order. '
                    'Attempt 1: the attempt 1 line. Attempt 2: say "' + vars['p' + k + '_a2_line'] + '" '
                    'If an offer was already said and refused, that attempt is used up. When both attempts are refused, make NO other offer.')
        else:
            rule = ('This product is in the early band: it has ONE persuasion attempt only, the attempt 1 line. '
                    'When the customer refuses it or does not answer it, make NO other offer for this product: no floor, no lower amount, no other date.')
        vars['p' + k + '_attempt_rule'] = rule
        vars['p' + k + '_floor_line'] = 'The lowest amount I can accept for your ' + x['words'] + ' is ' + money(x['floor']) + ', and the rest stays overdue.'
        pc = []
        xd = today
        while xd <= x['deadline'] + TD(days=21):
            tag = sp(xd) + ' (' + xd.isoformat() + ')' + (' [today]' if xd == today else '')
            if xd > x['deadline']:
                act = 'AFTER the deadline. Say the latest date you can record for it is ' + sp(x['deadline']) + ' and offer it.'
            elif isbiz(xd):
                act = 'OK, can be recorded.'
            else:
                why = 'a Freya Bank holiday' if xd.isoformat() in HOL else 'a weekend day'
                nb = nextbiz(xd)
                act = ('NOT allowed, ' + why + '. Offer the next business day, ' + sp(nb) + '.') if nb <= x['deadline'] else (
                      'NOT allowed, ' + why + '. Offer ' + sp(x['deadline']) + '.')
            pc.append('- ' + tag + ': ' + act)
            xd = xd + TD(days=1)
        vars['p' + k + '_calendar'] = '\n'.join(pc)
    dt = []
    xd = today
    while xd <= last + TD(days=21):
        tag = sp(xd) + ' (' + xd.isoformat() + ')' + (' [today]' if xd == today else '')
        if isbiz(xd):
            act = 'business day.'
        else:
            why = 'a Freya Bank holiday' if xd.isoformat() in HOL else 'a weekend day'
            act = 'NOT a business day (' + why + '). Offer the next business day, ' + sp(nextbiz(xd)) + '.'
        dt.append('- ' + tag + ': ' + act)
        xd = xd + TD(days=1)
    vars['day_table'] = '\n'.join(dt)
    vars['debt_line'] = line
    vars['n_products'] = str(n)
    vars['product_ids'] = ','.join(x['pid'] for x in prods)
    vars['product_list'] = '; '.join('product ' + str(x['n']) + ' = ' + x['words'] + ' (' + x['pid'] + ')' for x in prods)
    vars['products_block'] = '\n\n'.join(blocks)
    vars['deadlines_json'] = json.dumps(dict((x['pid'], x['deadline'].isoformat()) for x in prods))
    vars['limits_json'] = json.dumps(dict((x['pid'], [x['floor'], x['past']]) for x in prods))
    vars['week_table'] = '\n'.join(wk)
    vars['calendar'] = '\n'.join(cal)

Your only job in this step is the answer to that today question. Never ask about today again.

readback.name: readback
readback.task_message:
Every product has been handled. Products ({{n_products}}): {{product_list}}.

{{products_block}}

DATE WORDS
{{week_table}}

CALENDAR. Each line says, per product, what to do when the customer names that day:
{{calendar}}

Look at the whole conversation and work out, for each product in product order, its status: agreed (amount and date), refused, paid (they said they already paid it), dispute (they said it is not theirs or was closed), or hardship.
If the customer named one date for everything: each product is agreed at its full past-due amount on that date, except a product whose deadline is earlier: that product is agreed on its own deadline.

YOUR FIRST MESSAGE IN THIS STEP: if at least one product is agreed, the single read-back of all agreed products, ending with "Do you confirm?". If no product is agreed, call add_note for the first product.

NEVER ask "how much can you pay?" or any question that lets them choose the amount. You propose every amount.

READ-BACK (once, for all agreed products together)
- When every product is settled, read back ALL agreed products in ONE message: for each, the product, the amount and the date (weekday, day, month). If a product's date was moved to its own deadline, say so for that product. End with "Do you confirm?". Ask for one confirmation only.
- If they change a date or an amount, check the new value with the rules above and read everything back again.
- If no product is agreed, skip the read-back.

RECORD
- After a clear yes, call create_promise once per agreed product, in product order, one per message, with that product's product_id, the amount as a number and the date as YYYY-MM-DD.
- Follow what_to_do_next after each result. Never say a promise is recorded until create_promise said so. After all are recorded say once: "You will receive a text message confirming this promise."
- A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in this call; if asked, say they can change it in the mobile app.

NOTES (only when the call is NOT transferred)
- After the promises, call add_note once for every product without a recorded promise, one per message, with its product_id and its reason: refused, hardship, dispute, paid or service_error (create_promise failed twice).
- After a transfer, never call add_note.

CLOSE
- Then thank the customer, say goodbye, and in the same message call close_call.
- Outcome: promise if at least one promise was recorded. Otherwise paid if every product was noted paid. Otherwise no_promise with the reason of the first product, in product order, whose note is not paid.

on_enter.text: I am sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?

hardship.task_message:
The customer mentioned illness, a death in the family or losing their job. You have ALREADY said one sentence of sympathy and offered once to connect them with the customer support team. If they agreed a promise earlier in this call for some product, read those back once, ask "Do you confirm?" and record them with create_promise after a yes. Then call add_note with reason hardship for every product without a promise (keep paid or dispute for a product they said was paid or not theirs), one per message. Then thank them, say goodbye, and in the same message call close_call. Never ask them again.
- They ask for a discount or a waiver and have not answered the offer: say you cannot offer one. Nothing more.
- Their reply is cut off or about something else: say "Take your time." and nothing more.
- They ask for a new payment plan or lower instalments: describe no plan, call transfer_to_agent with queue restructuring. Call no add_note.
